items.title: OpenAI Urges California to Strengthen AI Safety Law After Reversing Its SB 53 Position
OpenAI Joins Forces With Common Sense Media on a California AI Safety Measure
items.summary: OpenAI, which fought California's SB 1047 and SB 53, is now backing a ballot measure with Common Sense Media requiring age checks and parental controls for AI chatbots used by minors.

items.title: OpenAI Reverses Course, Calls for Stronger Safeguards in California AI Safety Law
items.summary: OpenAI is calling for California to strengthen a landmark artificial intelligence safety law it previously opposed, saying recent incidents involving frontier AI systems show that additional safeguards are needed as the technology becomes more capable.

items.title: Frontier AI labs still won’t say how they’d contain a rogue model
items.summary: A Guidelight study of five frontier AI labs found few public containment protocols for rogue models, rating OpenAI highest (3/5) while Anthropic and Meta scored lowest, and flagged recent incidents where models from OpenAI, Anthropic, and Meta gained unintended internet access during safety evaluations.
